title: model version page Source Model link: render the logged model link only for models:/<model_id> sources, with a skeleton while loading and plain-ID fallback
answers: Why doesn't the model version page show a link to the logged model it was registered from?
A model version was registered from a model logged outside a run and has no Source Run row. How do I get to its artifacts from the version page?
Where is the Source Model row on the model version details page rendered and what does it show while loading or on error?
How do I add another row or link to the model version details description list without breaking the Copied from or Source Run entries?
body:
Path: The model version details page in the Model Registry UI (the Descriptions list on the version view) decides whether to show a source logged model row. It goes through mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry/components/ModelVersionView.tsx:ModelVersionViewImpl.renderSourceModelDescription, which reads model_version.source and renders ModelVersionSourceModelLink.
Rule: Only a source of the form models:/<model_id> produces the 'Source Model' row. ModelVersionSourceModelLink fetches the logged model via useGetLoggedModelQuery and renders three distinct states. While loading it shows a ParagraphSkeleton (data-testid source-model-loading). On fetch error, or when the logged model has no experiment_id, it shows the bare model ID as Typography.Text (source-model-id). Otherwise it links to Routes.getExperimentLoggedModelDetailsPageRoute(experiment_id, model_id), labelled with the logged model name or the ID if the name is empty.
Symptom: Versions registered from a model logged outside a run had no path to the model's artifacts, because the page showed no source rows at all. An earlier version collapsed loading, error and missing-experiment into the same bare-ID span, so the raw m-... hash flashed before the name resolved and a failed or deleted source model looked like a slow load.
Constraints: The row is absent for models:/<name>/<version> and alias sources, which keep the existing Copied from link. When adding a row, keep the Descriptions.Item label and data-testid stable, and in tests select rows by label text rather than by position. Tests should mock the full return shape of useGetLoggedModelQuery (isLoading, error, refetch, data) rather than a partial object cast to any.
applies: Model Registry model version details page in the MLflow OSS UI, when deciding how a version's source logged model is shown or changed.
says: The model version details page does not link to the original logged model.
Cannot access artifacts from the version view when a model is registered outside a run.
Raw model identifier numbers flash on screen before the source model name resolves.
Show a loading skeleton on the version page while retrieving source model details.
Display a fallback identifier when the source model link cannot be retrieved.
search: On the Model Registry model version details page, ModelVersionSourceModelLink renders a Source Model row only for sources matching models:/<model_id>. The component displays a ParagraphSkeleton while useGetLoggedModelQuery loads, falls back to a plain model ID on error or missing experiment ID, and otherwise links to the logged model details page. This row is omitted for alias or name-and-version sources, which preserve the existing Copied from row instead.
